A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same MVGS research work, with 20 complete pages including Appendices A–F. Text, equations, tables, figures, and rendered pages support reliable comparison; differences are confined to administrative metadata and the first-page arXiv stamp.

before.justification: v2 reports original MVGS reconstruction experiments in Section 4, component ablations, and additional quantitative and qualitative results in Appendices A–F.

after.justification: v3 retains those original MVGS experiments, ablations, and appendix results, including the proposed-method rows in Tables 1–9.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.4 retain identical multi-view regulated training, cross-intrinsic guidance, cross-ray densification, and multi-view augmented densification procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use Mip-NeRF 360, Tanks&Temples, Deep Blending, Shiny Blender, Glossy Synthetic, D-NeRF, and BungeeNeRF. The general, reflective, dynamic, and large-scale reconstruction coverage is identical, including appendix scenes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in corresponding main-text and appendix experiments. The comparisons involving 3DGS, Scaffold-GS, 3DGS-DR, 4DGS, Octree-GS, and their competing methods are unchanged.

E3.justification: Reported experimental settings and procedures are identical, including PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS evaluation, the 800×800 rendering resolution in Table 3, and the view-count and training-iteration sweeps.

E4.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendices A–B retain the same component ablations, view-count sensitivity analysis, and additional-training-iteration control. The HDR and normal reconstruction comparisons in Appendix D also remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical. Neither version adds repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and qualitative results in Tables 1–9 and Figures 1–12 are unchanged. For example, Table 3 reports the same 35.11 dB PSNR, 102 FPS, and 12 MB storage for 4DGS (+Ours) in both versions.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(4), their definitions, and the surrounding mathematical reasoning are identical. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same four contributions, broad applicability claims, and claim of approximately 1 dB PSNR improvement across tasks.

C2.justification: Interpretations and qualifications are identical, including the multi-view constraint explanation, the discussion of degradation with excessive views in Section 4.1, and the training-duration interpretation in Appendix B.

D1.justification: Implementation disclosures remain identical, including the view settings {48,24,12,8}, tau = 1, and reliance on baseline implementation settings. The code-availability statement and its project hyperlink are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the reference list, and positioning relative to NeRF and Gaussian-splatting methods are identical. No cited works or novelty relationships change.

P1.justification: The margin stamp changes from v2 dated 20 Sep 2025 to v3 dated 5 Feb 2026, and the embedded PDF title metadata is standardized. The displayed title, authors, prose, headings, and section order remain identical.

P2.justification: All 12 figures and nine tables retain identical formatting, captions, and placement, including appendix displays. Apart from the administrative margin stamp, the rendered page layouts are identical.

improvement.justification: The complete scientific text, evidence, explanations, and visual presentation are retained unchanged, including Appendices A–F. Updating the arXiv stamp and PDF metadata produces no meaningful difference in the paper's overall quality.
